reviews.text:
* I am not a client. I am a petsotter and this reviews is based solely on a clients pets reaction.

I get asked to take pets to different vets for this or that all the time. Normally they go in and are glued to me and are friendly but that's it. 1 of the pups I had to take in today was like that. He was ok with being there but that was it. The other one I had with me was literally crying if a vet or tech walked by without saying hi to her and then was all wiggles and loves when they did. I have NEVER seen her like that when they are with me and around people. She is always a happy girl but this was next level wiggles.
Every pet I saw entering the client was like that. Just happy to see everyone that works there. That to me says a lot.
Called and asked to set up appointment and lady hang up on me, no big deal I’ll call to different place

Absolutely wonderful, caring staff, just great with my animals and with my budget. Been with Dr Smith since his previous office and wouldn’t think of bringing my fur kids to anyone else. Excellent vet, up to date with all the latest treatments and the sweetest man in the world.
Love the customer service!
We have 2 rescue pups and they have always received the BEST care from all of the docs here.  The office staff and techs are efficient and friendly.

I am baffled as to why I got this survey.  I was referred to The Pet Wellness Center because my current vet did not have any available time for several days to see my sick cat.  The Pet Wellness Center could not see him either.  So we were never there. So I guess this survey is about a phone call  that I made to try and get an appointment???
Pet wellness is a great place. I brought my dog Bailey there from about 3 years old to 15 when she passed and they were there the whole way for me. Thank you pet wellness!
We just switched Vet’s due to an adverse experience. This place is amazing. My dog got the attention she deserved. Thank you!

I have seen may vets over the years with my dogs--many dogs over the years.  Had to get a new vet about every 3-4 years as I was transfered many times for work.  Doc Smith is at the TOP of my list as a new client.  Spent time with my dog, asked a ton of questions regarding the problem and answered all of my questions without being rushed out of the office.  He is TOP NOTCH!!  Even called with lab results and got meds that night to start treatment.  The ENTIRE office staff that I delt with were caring and very Professional.  Never had a vet sit on the floor and talk to my dog...wonderful experience!!  Dick Doubek

Dr Smith is the absolute best vet! Modi and I won’t go snywhere else. He gets on the floor with your pet and takes a lot of time with you. He looks for best solution for your pet and really cares. I highly recommend him. All of the staff are very friendly too. It’s a great experience all the way around!

Dr Smith is top notch. My dog had demodex mites and he was the first to mention getting to the root of the issue, not just treating the problem. I drive all the way from Scottsdale to go here bc he is worth it.
These guys are really there to help solve problems. I feel you can have people that understand both sides of the the needs that go on in pet care.
Great doctors and staff

Staff are very friendly. I brought in my mom's cat, who is very shy, and she went straight to the tech as well as the doc! Advice given was straightforward and very logical in nature, versus pushing money hungry motives. Hope this place stays open for years to come!
Very good with pets.  Explains everything clearly and carefully.  Not in a hurry to pad the bill before it is clear something needs to be done.

Kevin loved his first visit. Everyone was so nice.
Kitty hugs from Kevin to all.
Thank you, Sharon, for your 5-star rating! We're thrilled to know you had a positive experience with us. We look forward to serving you again soon!

I loved this place! All the staff not only loved my dog, but also my kids. Dr Lane Smith was amazing. He got on the floor for my dog, but didn't seem fazed when my kid was the first to climb on him like a jungle gym. Dr. Smith was very kind and thorough in asking questions to see what was necessary and what was not. I've been to many vets over the years of having animals, and I'll stick with Dr. Lane Smith as long as he stays at a reasonable distance from us.

0ur sadness of having our pets put down was extremely hard process Dr Lane and his assistant a young lady with Justin and Christine had every need met during this sad occasion.I felt uplifted during this the end the dignity of our pets was graciously maintained and we were included until the end.Thank you all for being there to make the process easier to handle.
Thank you, Tina, for your 5-star rating! We're thrilled to know you had a positive experience with us. We look forward to serving you again soon!

All of the doctors and staff are so professional and caring. They handle all of all of our pets’ healthcare needs. My husband and I recently and unexpectedly had to put down our 4 month old kitten. They were very understanding and respectful of our feelings. We were given all possible options to try to save her and were not rushed to make a decision. We highly recommend The Pet Wellness Center.
Took my dog Reilly here, the staff are great and really care about your animals. Highly recommend.

My dog has a complex medical history and the staff at Pet Wellness Center have been so helpful with getting her the resources she needs and make her comfortable and feel safe at the clinic. I appreciate everything they've done for me and my dog. Definitely recommend

This team has taken such great care of my cat over the last 2 years. Very grateful how they handle all clients who come in and give him so much love and care. Very professional as well! Thank you Pet Wellness Center team!

This place is trying to capitalize as much as possible. They want to provide additional fees that are unnecessary in order to make their pocketbooks larger than what is necessary. Choose a different vet. They are actually more expensive than vets in the San Francisco Bay area.

We finally found our forever vet! Dr Smith and his amazing assistant Maria are absolute rockstars.
Our Belgian Malinois has a reputation for being quite protective of us and can come across as aggressive or standoffish with strangers. She’s seen several different vets in the past, and every single one struggled to even get close to her. From the very first visit, Dr Smith and Maria handled her beautifully. They were calm, confident, and clearly knew exactly how to work with a strong, protective breed like hers.
Within minutes, our princess went from wary to completely relaxed and even affectionate with both of them! She genuinely fell in love with them! It was such a relief to see her comfortable and happy at the vet for the first time.
Dr Smith is knowledgeable, thorough, and genuinely cares about his patients (and their humans). Maria is kind, patient, and has a real gift with nervous or protective dogs. Their team made what is usually a stressful experience into something positive and even enjoyable.
If you have a challenging or protective dog, look no further. We couldn’t recommend Dr Smith and Maria highly enough. We’ve found our vet home for life. Thank you both so much!
The Pet Wellness center is an amazing facility with well educated staff and Dr. Smith is amazing. I would highly recommend this facility.
Great care!

We love how friendly the staff and physicians are at TLC.

They always take care of our German Shepherd, Chloe in a timely and caring manner as well as explain all the details of her appointment to us during our visits.
First went here several years ago with our great Dane. Moved further away, and tried other, closer vets. I regret that; now, we will just drive a little further to come here and see Dr Smith.

Yesterday we had to make the difficult decision to lay our beautiful fury baby Laverne to rest. Everyone at this center was nothing short of amazing. The veterinarian yesterday 2/19 was I believe his name was Lane. Lane my husband and I could not thank you enough for the discussion and letting us know it was time we did this before she was any worse and any more suffering took place. God bless you, and thank you for taking our baby over to the rainbow bridge.
Thank you, Austen, for your 5-star rating! We're thrilled to know you had a positive experience with us. We look forward to serving you again.

A phenomenal practice with Dr. Smith and staff. My French Bulldog was a patient here for 7 years, and she was always cared for with so much love and compassion. Even during her passing, the staff treated her and us with such kindness. They gave her a sundae, a quiet, peaceful space, and all the time we needed to be with her. She passed so peacefully surrounded by the team we’ve come to think of as family. We are forever grateful for the care and dignity they gave her in her final moments.

The Pet Wellness Center off Dove Valley in Phoenix is nothing short of extraordinary, and Dr. Stinnett is an absolute gem.

We’ve known for years how wonderful this place is, they’ve cared for several of our dogs over time, but this visit was especially meaningful and unforgettable. We brought in our 15-year-old, three-legged, amazing boy Jake after one of the scariest mornings we’ve ever experienced. He woke up unable to walk, unable to see, and in severe pain. He had also experienced a seizure earlier, and given his age and sudden decline, we were truly afraid this might be the day we had to say goodbye.

Dr. Stinnett took the time to give Jake a thorough, thoughtful exam, ran blood work, and, most importantly, treated him with compassion, confidence, and care. She knew, even when we were unsure, that this was not Jake’s time. While the exact cause of his episode wasn’t fully clear, Dr. Stinnett was confident that Jake still had good life ahead of him and she was absolutely right.

Just four days later, Jake was back to his normal self. Seeing him walking, seeing, and acting like our happy boy again felt nothing short of miraculous.

The entire team at The Pet Wellness Center truly cares for your pets as if they were their own family. That kind of genuine compassion is rare, and it means everything when you’re facing one of the hardest moments as a pet parent.

We highly—HIGHLY—recommend The Pet Wellness Center and Dr. Stinnett. You will immediately see that this is a special place filled with people who truly love what they do.

Thank you, Dr. Stinnett and the entire staff, for giving us more time with our beloved Jake. We will be forever grateful. 🐾❤️
Dr. Smith and the entire team at The Pet Wellness Center always take great care of my buddy Moose!  He always looks forward to all the love and attention he gets as soon as he walks in the door :)

Dr Smith and the staff have been amazing with my girls! When my oldest got sick they were all there for me and my family as we made the hardest decision of our lives. Love each and everyone of them ❤️
Thank you for caring for our little ones. You are all appreciated 🐾💜

I’ve been bringing my dogs here for over 10 years for grooming and for all of their medical needs and they’ve always done a great job. Highly recommend them. Jen Does a great job grooming all of my dogs.

Dr. Lane Smith has treated my cats for several years. He is professional, knowledgeable, compassionate, and considers my cats as his own. His communication skills are superior and he encourages his clients to be a partner in the care of their animal companions. The Veterinary technicians and office staff are outstanding. Cannot recommend enough.

Dr Smith and staff are great with our pets and show they care. I have since referred several people to Dr Smith and ALL love him and will be going there going forward. I highly recommend Pet Wellness Center and Dr Smith.

From the time you walk in to the time you leave you know you have come to the best vet! Friendly staff and a wonderful veterinarian. Dr. Smith is very attentive to all details in the care of our dog. Highly recommend The Pet Wellness Center.
Very nice staff. I will be taking all 3 of my pups to this practice. Highly recommend Pet Wellness.

Best experience at a veterinary practice I’ve had in a very long time. And I have many animals of my own and many that come and go in foster care. From the moment I walked in the door to the front office, until I left. Dr. Lane Smith not only had the best Interaction with my pet from beginning to the end he definitely put me at ease and made my pet feel very comfortable. She’s not the easiest. The technician understood all my concerns as well and took his time with her. If you want to go to the best veterinarian place, you should go here. You won’t regret it!
Dr Lane and his staff are extremely caring and personable. The only place we will take our fur babies!

I drive 45 minutes to see Dr. Lane. I’m fussy about the vet I choose. I’m looking for someone who stays current on the newest science-based approaches to wellness and is also open minded to more conservative holistic approaches. I never feel rushed. His front office staff and techs are also exceptional.
veterinarian was a very knowledgeable and nice will return

We brought our pet in and didn't get the run around of tests like most veterinarians seem to do these days. Would highly recommend if you're tired of the games some veterinarians like to play to drive up costs. We will gladly bring our 2 other dogs here.
Hi Jacqueline, thank you so much for sharing your star review for our hospital! We appreciate your feedback.

I am very happy with my experience here. They were able to squeeze me in when my dog was having an emergency. She unfortunately needed to be euthanized and all of the staff were so kind and caring. They never made me feel rushed or inconvenienced. My family was able to spend as much time as we needed before and after. Dr. Smith was so kind and explained everything. I highly recommend the Pet Wellness Center.

Wow I am so amazed at obtaining an appointment so quickly! I really loved the way they treated Paco with total patience and respect. The doctor and assistant were absolutely amazing and Paco left feeling very comfortable.

I recently moved to North Phoenix and needed a vet.  I was most fortunate in finding Dr Smith and staff.  Dr Smith is straight forward, articulate, knowledgeable and readily available.  The staff Justin, Christine Jackie, et al. are fantastic.  They leave us feeling  valued, important and always are helpful and pleasant.  Dakota is never reluctant to go to their office!  This review isn't based on 1 visit.  Dakota has been going monthly for injections since 11/2024 and he had his teeth cleaned yesterday.  Thank you for providing the community with this great office.
What an incredible practice. The crew and the Dr. smith are amazing. Justin is a master technician. Very professional, very courteous, and ready to save the day. I applaud thee!

Great experience with Dr. Smith recently. He was patient, and easy going. Easy to talk with and helpful.  He did not push anything that was not needed for my senior dog. I would recommend  if you are needing a great vet!
Glad the one vet left. My dog has been suffering. I've spent several hundreds of dollars and no answers. Then the vet left early and so now my dog is just SOL. Thanks for your compassion and care.
Really friendly and very helpful will keep comeing back 10 outa 10

My experience with this vet was excellent from start to finish. Every staff member from the first phone call to the follow up calls after the appointment showed the upmost care and concern for my animals. The vet tech was friendly and attentive, loving on my pups as he completed intake. Dr. Smith spent the entire appointment on the floor loving on my pups and going over every symptom and possible treatment option for my dog who was experiencing abnormal seizure activity and muscle tremors. While my old vet was dismissive and did absolutely nothing for her, this clinic went above and beyond to evaluate her and provide treatment for her condition without burdensome costs. I hadn’t intended changing vets when I initially made this appointment, but The Pet Wellness Clinic has stolen the hearts of my fur babies so there’s really no going back.
They love my pets as much as I do. They made special designs on my dog's cast every week! Great vets here, definitely recommend 👍 …

The absolute best!! Dr. Smith is kind, compassionate and real. The entire staff is so patient and they genuinely care! The service we receive is ALWAYS top notch! My current pup gets incredibly nervous and struggles with new people, but because of Dr.  Smith’s dedication to making his patients feel safe, she is the most relaxed I’ve ever seen her!

I’ve been taking my all of my dogs here since they opened (desert hills animal clinic, their sister spot before that) and I simply won’t go anywhere else - Even when I moved out of town!!! There’s no need to shop around, The Pet Wellness Center is the way to go.

I took my senior pup to establish care at this vet since we live very close and I also wanted them to check a small mass that he has growing on his head. The doctor was very nice and recommended not doing a biopsy but to just remove the mass at the same time as a dental cleaning under anesthesia. The appointment was very quick and they did the other quick normal checks (temperature, asked about diet, etc). This appointment cost $89! That is the most I've ever paid for a check up at a vet in this state and two other states I've lived in.

The doctor said they would give me a quote for the dental cleaning and the mass removal and the vet tech said he would get that to me by end the of the day or by the end of the week (this was on a Monday). Next Tuesday rolled around and I still had not heard from them so I called in the morning and they apologized and said they would send the quote.

I received the quote that evening, but the quote was only for the mass removal at $1874.00 - $2332.57. I asked to know if this included the dental cleaning. It's now Thursday, almost two weeks after the initial appointment and the person responding to the email said it was only for the mass removal but that the tech could write me a quote for dental cleaning if I want. They also said they noticed a double charge on the quote so the mass removal quote is actually $1404 - $1862. I should mention that the mass is smaller than the size of a dime on a 13 pound pup.

I was dumbfounded that they were asking if I wanted a dental cleaning quote as I had already discussed that with the vet and the tech that they would quote me for both.

In this timeframe, I was able to get two quotes from other vets and the total quote from these other places (dental and mass removal) were cheaper than the quote for just the mass removal at The Pet Wellness Center. Needless to say, we will be going elsewhere - doing the bloodwork, dental cleaning, and mass removal at a quote of less than $1000!

I highly recommend not wasting your time and money and doing the research to find somewhere else to go. The Humane Society does dental cleanings at low-cost as well as many other vets with great reviews in the valley.
This place is awesome and the whole staff is so amazing and loving. Dr Smith is so good and really wants to make your pet feel lots better. He truly loves his patients.

I will start by saying the staff is great. BUT they should be wearing mask and holding guns when you walk in, so you know that they are there to rob you of every penny! A year ago I went to another Veterinarian, had my Chihuahuas anal gland treated after she burst one of hers. That costed $126.00. Today I went here they charged me $304.00! They did the samething the another vets did  for my Chihuahua. I had to leave without meds for my Chihuahua. I did ask for a Prescription for the medication for her anal glad. They were charging me almost 80.00 I went to Walmart got it for $25.00! So if you have money to throw away this your place. When went to the Frys next door the deli worker told me they rough up her elderly dog when they trying to cut her dogs nails. They rough the dog so mad that she had put her dog down due to some injuries he got while getting his nails cut!!

Dr Smith and his staff were so caring and thorough, and my bashful doggy approached them. She usually shies away from strangers. They were our "2nd opinion" and came up with an alternative to the suggested surgery.  And if surgery is needed, he's half the cost of the previous vet.

Dr. Lane Smith, Justin and the entire team at The Pet Wellness Center is phenomenal!  They were totally committed to caring for everything our dog Sierra needed.  Their compassion and attention to her and her care were beyond exemplary.  We could not asked for or expected anything more.  No one should be uncertain or concerned about taking their pet here.  We would highly recommend them.

Dr Smith is amazing and very kind. His staff is courteous and compassionate and you can tell that everybody there really cares about the well-being of your pet. They always go above and beyond to help out the little fur babies and provide excellent care.

BEST EXPERIENCE EVER! Dr. Lane Smith LISTENS to you and takes the time to explain and answer questions, and repeatedly checks in if there is anything else left unanswered or not addressed. It shows that every one of the staff at The Pet …
Hi and thank you so much for this review! We appreciate you entrusting us with your furry best friend!
Hi Paul, thank you so much for this review! We appreciate you entrusting us with your furry best friend!

We would not take Taz anywhere else. Dr. Smith and the whole staff are extremely caring. We had an emergency with Taz and they told us to bring him right in and they would keep him and fit him in. They called us later in the say to pick him …
Hi Lisa, thank you so much for this review! We appreciate you entrusting us with your furry best friend!

This vet's compassion and sensitivity is unequalled. I have consistently had a good experience here , whether just calling with a question or taking my pet in for a ln issue or wellness visit. I highly recommend!
